cohort: The study included 136 low-risk pregnant individuals who gave birth at Selcuk University Faculty of Medicine Hospital between January 1, 2023, and September 30, 2023.
finding: Oxytocin and carbetocin demonstrated similar efficacy in the prophylaxis of postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: No statistically significant difference in estimated blood loss was observed between carbetocin and oxytocin groups in either vaginal births or Cesarean sections.
